steps.body: An **estimate** is a smart guess made before measuring — close to the real length, not exact. If a book is about 9 inches long, a good estimate is close to 9, like 8 or 10 — not 20.

choices.label: 20 inches
choices.feedback: 20 is much too far from 9 to be a good estimate.

steps.body: A good estimate doesn't need to be exact — just in the right neighborhood. Being off by 1 or 2 inches is fine; being off by 10 or more is not.
